The provider is the originating external dependency. Gateway 503s and analytics 429 drops are downstream. Caveat: the timeouts could also be read as dependency_timeout. A separate account-svc migration fault (0094_add_status_v2, lines 3948-3989, 4089) breaks /login, not the events path.

verdict.recommendedAction: Confirm the geo-IP provider outage with the provider. Configure enrichment to fail open or skip the geo lookup on provider errors, with short timeouts under 1s, so ingest-api stops returning 503 when its circuit opens. Separately, restore accounts.status_v2 (migration 0094 left the column renamed after a non-transactional step 1 and a lock-timeout failure on step 2), then verify /login recovers.

The provider is the originating external dependency. Gateway 503s and analytics 429 drops are downstream. Caveat: the timeouts could also be read as dependency_timeout. A separate account-svc migration fault (0094_add_status_v2, lines 3948-3989, 4089) breaks /login, not the events path.

input.recommendedAction: Confirm the geo-IP provider outage with the provider. Configure enrichment to fail open or skip the geo lookup on provider errors, with short timeouts under 1s, so ingest-api stops returning 503 when its circuit opens. Separately, restore accounts.status_v2 (migration 0094 left the column renamed after a non-transactional step 1 and a lock-timeout failure on step 2), then verify /login recovers.
